title: Dashboard: Summary Statistics by Language
description: Learning stats with language breakdown. MOBILE-FIRST responsive stat cards.

technicalContext.ui: Stats cards with numbers + language breakdown
technicalContext.responsive: MOBILE-FIRST: 2-column stat grid on mobile, 4-column on desktop
technicalContext.tailwind: Use Tailwind: grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4, responsive text sizing

acceptanceCriteria.text: Create query to aggregate user stats across all tables
Calculate: total unique words, total lines practiced, total practice time
Show big number cards: Words Learned, Lines Practiced, Time Spent
Show language breakdown (e.g., 'Persian: 150 words, Hebrew: 30 words')

Show 'Most practiced song' with title and practice count

UI: Consistent card styling, accent colors for each stat type
